info.bio:
Thompson Twins (1977-1993) fue un grupo de New Wave de gran éxito en los años ochenta con ventas estimadas en 50 millones de copias. El nombre del grupo es tomado del nombre en inglés de los gemelos investigadores que aparecen en las historias de Las Aventuras de Tintín y que en el mundo hispano se conocen como Hernández y Fernández.


 Inicios  
En 1977, el grupo tenía como integrantes a Tom Bailey (nació el 18 de Enero de 1954 en Halifax, Yorkshire), Pete Dodd , John Roog y Jon Podgorski (conocido como "Pod").

scenes.name: Segunda invasión británica y MTV
scenes.book: Postpunk. Romper todo y empezar de nuevo
scenes.author: Simon Reynolds
scenes.desc: En 1982 el new pop deja de ser un sueño de periodistas: «Don't You Want Me», «Tainted Love» y «The Look of Love» anuncian una nueva invasión, y en 1983 la segunda camada (Duran Duran, Culture Club, Wham!, Eurythmics, Thompson Twins) conquista Estados Unidos gracias a MTV, canal ideado por Michael Nesmith que, sin vídeos americanos, dependía de los británicos, más videogénicos y cultivados en el estilo («I want my MTV»). A Flock of Seagulls, Altered Images («Happy Birthday»), Simple Minds («Promised You a Miracle», New Gold Dream), Haircut 100, Kajagoogoo; Bowie se broncea con «Let's Dance». El new pop reexporta música negra (Chic, P-Funk, Quincy Jones) a la América blanca. En el Reino Unido, 1983 se vive en cambio como un año infausto: reelección de Thatcher, «Kill Ugly Pop» en las paredes y la vuelta de la conciencia social.

podcast.title: Part of the 1984 British Chart Dominance
podcast.body: By April 1984, the Thompson Twins were among the British acts contributing to the fact that 40% of the Hot 100 was British, alongside Eurythmics and Duran Duran. "By April 84, 40% of the hot 100 was British, including hits by the Thompson Twins."

podcast.title: MTV Era Popularity
podcast.body: Part of the wave of "fun, fresh music" from the UK that became popular in North America due to exposure on MTV in its early days. "There was Durand Durant and the Human League and Blomage and the Thompson Twins and Soft Cell."

xref.title: Art House Upholsterer
xref.body: After her time with the British techno pop group Thompson Twins in the 1980s, percussionist Alannah Currie became an art house upholsterer. In this role, she designs and creates "exotic and insanely expensive pieces of furniture." "percussionist Alana Curry is an art house, a pollsterer. xref.title: Session and Touring Musician
xref.body: Collins was a highly sought-after guitarist, frequently called upon by producer Nile Rodgers for recordings with his clients, including Madonna. She also toured with George Clinton and P-Funk and served as the studio and touring guitarist for the Thompson Twins during their peak in the mid-1980s. "For that, she was a go-to person for guitarist and producer Nile Rogers, who had her play on many records for his clients, including Madonna."
